# Aslam Local Visibility

> Organic local visibility for coaches and consultants. I help them get seen, trusted and booked in their own city through short-form Reels, branded design, Google Business Profile optimization, a booking landing page and community engagement on LinkedIn and Reddit. No ads, ever. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh; working remotely with clients worldwide.

- [Compare](https://bbrfeed.online/compare/): How organic local visibility compares with big agencies and generic freelancers, plus what each tier includes.

## What I do

- Content production: short-form Reels and branded graphics.
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile optimization.
- Digital storefront: a landing page built to turn visitors into booked calls.
- Community authority: engagement on LinkedIn and Reddit.

## Services

- Presence Builder ($500/month): 8 Reels per month, 8 branded designs per month, landing page setup, Google Business Profile optimization, LinkedIn management.
- Visibility Engine ($750/month): 10 Reels per month, 10 branded designs per month, landing page setup, Google Business Profile optimization, LinkedIn management, Reddit community engagement, monthly performance report.
- City Authority ($1200/month): 15 Reels per month, 15 branded designs per month, landing page setup, Google Business Profile optimization, LinkedIn management, Reddit community engagement, monthly performance report, full professional website build and management, advanced content strategy, priority support.

## Founding Client offer

4 spots: the Tier 2 (Visibility Engine) package for $500/month for the first 3 months, in exchange for a testimonial and permission to use results as a case study.

## Booking

- [Book a free visibility audit](https://cal.com/mdaslam)

## What I do not do

- I do not run paid ads (Google Ads, Facebook Ads). All work is organic.
- Tier 1 and Tier 2 do not include a full custom website. A full website build is part of Tier 3 only.
- I do not work with YouTubers, gamers, dropshippers or entertainers.

## Notes

- Typical timeline: more profile views and engagement within about 30 days; local search ranking improvement within about 60-90 days.
